descByPlatform.chatgpt: Environmental Editorial Portrait for Architect at Drafting Table studio feature. Setting: industrial loft studio, concrete-wall #8B8880 background with vertical steel sash windows softly blurred, scale models and rolled tubes on mid-shelf, adjustable Anglepoise with warm-brass-lamp #C08A3E shade angled over desk. Composition: Rule of Thirds eyes 38% x 36% y, Eye-Level 0° slight 6° subject tilt, 3:4 editorial vertical, working waist-up, subject 55% of frame. Camera: Sony A7R V, 50mm G Master at f/2.5, 1/125s, ISO 320, handheld. Lighting: Desk Lamp Key + Window Ambient — Anglepoise warm 3000K with 8-inch diffusion sock camera-right 40° 0.6m (key motivated), 4×6ft silk north window camera-left 2.2m (ambient fill), 2×3ft negative flag camera-right 1.0m (contrast shape). Skin: Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush. Capture One Warm-10 LUT grain 8 +0.1 EV. References: Platon WSJ Mag Architect, Juergen Teller i-D, Dezeen Studio Visits. Exclude: plastic skin, flat lighting, cluttered desk, color cast, logo distortion.
